The company is also developing techniques for partial policy evaluation and authorizing API calls, as seen in 'Partial policy evaluation' and 'Method and apparatus to reduce the window for policy violations with minimal impact.' Additional work includes viewing aggregate policies and validating policies and data in API authorization systems. These areas reflect Styra’s focus on policy management and API authorization.

overview_description.description:
Styra offers a platform that allows companies to enforce and monitor authorization policies across cloud-native applications. Styra delivers a fully managed Open Policy Agent platform with a built-in library of policies that allow customers to implement authorization policy-as-code. Prerunning supports the monitoring and validating of policy changes before committing, mitigating risk predeployment. Meanwhile, declarative models outline the desired state to prevent security drift and eliminate errors before they occur.

Styra works with cloud-native APIs to define, enforce, and keep tabs on policies before runtime. The platform takes in a business context and outputs security decisions across namespaces and clusters, letting customers write policy once and enact it where necessary.

product.name: Enterprise OPA Platform
product.description: A platform for fine-grained, policy-based authorization that supports cloud migration, Zero Trust, and application modernization across various architectures.

product.name: Enterprise OPA
product.description: An enterprise-grade distribution of Open Policy Agent optimized for data-heavy authorization workloads with improved memory and CPU efficiency.

product.name: Low-Code Policy Builder
product.description: A tool that enables business users and analysts to author and deploy authorization policies without coding, featuring automated regression analysis and approval workflows.

product.name: Workforce Authorization
product.description: Policy-based access control solution to manage employee access, minimizing risks from credential compromise and insider threats.

product.name: Customer Authorization
product.description: A scalable authorization platform to provide secure and seamless access for customers to applications.

product.name: Data Access Filtering
product.description: Authorization platform feature that enforces row-level and column-level data access controls for employees and customers.
